task: fix ALL outstanding defects (the naming wave is deferred by owner ruling)

defects.symptom: agent_teams_update_task with an `amend` payload on a RUNNING task never returns (the caller saw 'interrupted after it was recorded, but no result durably recorded')
defects.rootCause: our delta region `mpd-delta update-task-amend-running` called scheduler.kickTeam(...) INSIDE withTeamLock(teamLockKey(...)); kickTeam -> kickMember -> withTeamLock re-acquires the SAME key, and withTeamLock is a non-reentrant promise chain, so the inner acquisition waits for the outer one that awaits it
defects.fix: removed the inner kick; the call site below the lock already kicks once for every path through the tool
defects.proof: packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/test/update-task-amend-lock-and-guards.test.mjs — RED (kick re-introduced) = 'DEADLOCK: ... did not settle within 1500 ms' (1516 ms); GREEN (fixed) = pass in 25 ms

defects.symptom: a MEMBER's `amend` returned success and persisted NOTHING (measured 4x by a member)
defects.fix: region `mpd-delta update-task-amend-captain-only`: a member passing `amend` is refused loudly and pointed at the captain

defects.symptom: a changed findings/verdict/acceptanceResults/commandsRun/changedPaths on a TERMINAL task answered success while the record was unchanged (seen as `resolved` staying false)
defects.fix: region `mpd-delta update-task-terminal-immutable-fields` + helper `terminalTaskChangedField`; every field is compared and any real change is refused loudly

defects.symptom: a captain could not amend a task that had not started (`pending` was not an accepted status value), so a defective contract forced a fail-and-retry cycle
defects.fix: `pending` added to the status enum + description (region `update-task-required-status-param`)

defects.symptom: `npm run pack` exited 0 while the packed tree OMITTED packages/mpd-team-compact-plugin (which the bundle patch mounts as loader entry `mpd-team-compact`), so a packed install died with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on that entry; a checkout install was unaffected, which is why no gate caught it
defects.rootCause: scripts/pack-mpd.mjs PLUGIN_PKGS listed 13 plugin packages and never included mpd-team-compact-plugin
defects.fix: added it to PLUGIN_PKGS with the rule spelled out in-file (every package the patch mounts must be listed; mpd-qa-roles-probe stays out because an overlay mounts it)
defects.proof: pack + completeness check = 19/19 mounted packages present; the real packed-boot QA case now gets past the loader rows (no mpd-team-compact import error) and stops only at MISSING_CREDENTIAL, the documented sandbox-credential requirement

defects.symptom: a roster member the profile calls READ-ONLY still held write/edit/bash in a TEAM: the member spawn passed toolFilter.deny = CAPTAIN_TOOL_NAMES alone and the restriction was prompt-level ('never edit files'). Measured from inside a member's own session, whose probe ran `pwd` for real
defects.rootCause: the one-shot roster path denies the seven write-capable names (READONLY_DENY) but the TEAM path had no equivalent, and the adopted plugin cannot import across packages
defects.fix: `toolDeny` (string[]) as PROFILE DATA, threaded end to end: profiles.js parses/validates it, the zod Config keeps it, members.js merges it into the harness toolFilter, tools.js `agent_teams_add_member` accepts it; the shipped `mpd` profile now marks exactly the six read-only members with the seven canonical names
defects.proof: packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/test/member-readonly-deny.test.mjs (4 tests): parser normalizes/rejects, spawn passes the merged list (workers keep only the captain denial), the shipped profile data equals the canonical names, add_member exposes the parameter

defects.symptom: live QA cases staged `.credentials.yaml` but not `settings.yaml`, so on a home whose model chain comes from gateway providers the sandbox fell back to the base `deepseek-official` route and died with MISSING_CREDENTIAL
defects.fix: the documented AGENTS.md §7 idiom added to the 11 cases that lacked it (codegraph-smoke, agent-teams-sidebar, bundle-lifecycle, memory-smoke, plan-c-smoke, preset-register, relocate-smoke, team-route-rewire, tool-output-validation, ultrawork-smoke, workmate-team-member)
defects.proof: bundle-lifecycle flipped red→green; agent-teams-sidebar green. The remaining live cases need a real model credential this environment does not have (see environmentGaps)

defects.symptom: registering a region in a file the self-fix fixtures did not stage made the applier walk the registry against a scratch tree and die with ENOENT (13 tests)
defects.fix: both fixtures now DERIVE their file lists from MPD_DELTAS, so a newly registered region file can never break them again
defects.proof: packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin (206 pass / 0 fail) after the change
